source.name: platinum_tier_ms_master.pdf
source.classification: user-supplied compiled reference; mixed official, secondary, academic and derived content

claims.claim: Operating standards universe contains 17 Malaysian halal-related standards/contexts.
MS 1500:2019 is the current project food baseline.
MS 2400-1/-2/-3:2019 are the current project supply-chain standards for transportation, warehousing and retailing.
MS 2738:2023 and MS 2803:2025 represent the current consumable-goods / animal bone-skin-hair architecture used for new work.
MPPHM 2020 is amended by Pekeliling Pensijilan Halal Malaysia Bil. 1/2026 effective 1 April 2026.
claims.repository_action: do not promote exact amendment rules

claims.claim: Specific MPPHM fee ranges presented in the PDF are current in 2026.
claims.source_required: current official JAKIM fee schedule with scheme/category applicability

claims.claim: SPHM validity is universally two years from issuance.
claims.source_required: current JAKIM certificate-validity rule by applicable scheme/context

claims.claim: Audit minimum is four days including two audit days and two travel days for one manufacturing address.
claims.source_required: current official JAKIM audit-duration instruction and applicability

claims.claim: JAKIM document review is completed in 14 working days.
Corrective action findings must universally close within 14 days.
Annual surveillance audit is universal.
MHMS 2020 distinguishes IHCS for the relevant small/micro profile and HAS for the relevant medium/large profile.
claims.repository_action: retain separate IHCS and HAS profiles

claims.claim: Every certified operating branch requires a qualified Halal Executive under the 2026 amendment.
New halal-sensitive staff require training within three months and refresher training every three years.
Management review must occur semiannually.
MHMS compliance records must universally be retained for at least three years.
New SPHM applications require at least three months of active compliance records.
Numeric alcohol limits presented as fatwa critical-limit translations can be used directly as universal machine rules.
claims.source_required: specific current fatwa instrument, context, jurisdiction and applicability

claims.claim: All raw materials must universally be halal-certified.
claims.repository_action: replace with material-risk/source/certification evidence logic bound to the applicable requirement

claims.claim: All halal transportation must universally use dedicated transport.
claims.repository_action: use applicable MS2400 segregation/contamination controls rather than universal dedicated-only assertion

claims.claim: PCR/DNA verification is required at receipt for all high-risk inputs.
MS 2627 testing uses the exact universal LOD and Ct ranges printed in the checklist.
claims.source_required: licensed current method text / validated laboratory method

claims.claim: MS 2809 universally requires at least 30 reference samples/class, >=95% sensitivity and annual independent validation.
MS 2810 universally requires the exact positive-control Ct value printed in the checklist.
claims.source_required: current licensed MS 2810:2025 normative text / validated laboratory method

claims.claim: The official Department of Standards Malaysia MySOL halal catalogue is available at the PDF-listed MySOL search endpoint.
claims.repository_action: add controlled live-source endpoint as catalogue discovery only

non_negotiable_boundary: No claim in this register creates or substitutes for JAKIM/MAIN/JAIN certification, fatwa authority, laboratory accreditation or GCC destination release.
promotion_rule: A SOURCE_LOCKED, SECONDARY_ONLY, CANDIDATE_CONTROL or OPEN_GATE claim cannot become a production rule until the required source is captured, versioned, applicability-mapped and authority-gated.
